name: Ocean Buddy
subtitle: Water Sports Spots & Trips
promotionalText: Explore more than 700 water sports spots, discover the cultures of 118 countries and plan your next trip, with your favorites and notes in one place.
description:
Your next trip starts with Ocean Buddy.

Explore more than 700 spots for surfing, diving, snorkeling, paddleboarding, kayaking and other water sports. Pick an activity, browse regions and discover each destination through images (photos or, when none is available, clearly labeled illustrations), practical details and a map for each activity. Information still being verified is clearly marked.

PLAN YOUR TRIP
Create an itinerary, add stops, organize dates and keep your notes in one place. Save your favorites and share a copy of your trip.

TAKE TIME TO EXPLORE
Spin the planet in Explore and dive toward the spot that calls to you. Browse immersive galleries and get to know each spot: activities, skill level guidance, access and things to watch out for. If you like, turn on ambient sound and subtle terrain shading. Weather conditions with timestamps help you prepare when you’re online.

TRAVEL THROUGH CULTURES
Each of the 118 countries has its own page. Depending on the country, you’ll find words in the local language, a dish to try, a tip on the right thing to do, a sea tradition or a festival, with the source of every fact. Every day, a word of the day to guess: find which country says it and earn its stamp. Opening a country’s page also gives you its stamp.

AN ACCOUNT, IF YOU LIKE
The account is free and optional: the app stays fully usable without it. With your email address (we send you a code, no password), find your favorites, trips, notes and progress on another device. You can export everything or delete your account from Settings. Reserved for people aged 15 and over.

MEET POULPY
Poulpy joins you as you explore: it answers your questions right in the app, from Ocean Buddy’s spot pages and guides, even offline. Its tips do not replace local information.

KEEP YOUR JOURNAL WITH YOU
The catalog and included photos remain available offline. Without an account, your favorites, trips and notes stay on your device. Weather, map tiles and the account require an internet connection.

Ocean Buddy helps you plan an outing. Actual conditions, local guidance and your instructors or guides always take priority. The app does not book services and does not replace required qualifications or a marine navigation or diving tool.
